title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes
body:
* **Custom calculations with Genie Code**: Genie Code can now write custom calculations that reference other custom calculations in the same dataset. See [Referencing other calculations](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/data-modeling/custom-calculations#reference-calculations).
* **Sort pivot tables**: Viewers can now sort pivot tables by row and column. See [Table and pivot table visualizations](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/visualizations/tables).
* **Pivot table header styles**: Authors can now style pivot table headers separately for each row, column, and value field. See [Style pivot table headers](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/visualizations/tables#pivot-header-style).
* **Pivot table text wrapping**: Pivot table values can now adjust their height to wrap text.
* **Pivot table divider**: Authors can now resize the divider between columns and values in a pivot table.
* **Associative filtering**: Authors can now turn off associative filtering between dashboard filters. See [Configure filter application behavior](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/settings#apply-filters).
* **Undo and redo for dashboard variables**: Actions on dashboard variables now support undo and redo. See [Use dashboard variables](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/filters/dashboard-variables).
* **Ask Genie on supported widgets**: **Ask Genie** now appears only on widgets that Genie can use as context. It no longer appears on images, filters, or older text boxes.
* **Waterfall chart axis**: The y-axis on waterfall charts now extends so data labels aren't cut off.
